technique_name: List three facts about the element Sodium.
description: Sodium is a chemical element with the symbol Na and atomic number 11. It is a silvery-white, soft, and easily malleable member of the alkali group of metals. Sodium is an essential element for all living organisms, and is the most abundant of the alkali metals found in natural sources. Some of its notable physical properties are its low melting point, low density, and high reactivity. It is the sixth most abundant element by mass in both the Earth and the human body, and is essential for life. I
